name: PLLS
description: Capsule forms negotiating a shared field. Density archetypes decide how many; finishes decide the skin; a seeded chance settles every dispute.

name: KRRTK
description: Karratuak. A square deciding, again and again, whether to divide. Recursive subdivision against a threshold — structure as the only ornament.

name: KRRTKG
description: The recursive squares of KRRTK set over weather: a mesh-gradient field beneath, film grain above. Structure meets atmosphere.

name: DTK
description: Borobilak. An n×n grid of circles where a threshold decides which ones get to exist. Presence as probability.

name: DTKG
description: The circle grid of DTK breathing over a mesh gradient, sealed with film grain. The order stays; air gets in.

name: BZRS
description: Hundreds of Bézier curves, each one a gradient between two colours of the palette. A single gesture repeated until it becomes fabric.

name: PLLSG
description: The capsules of PLLS given weather: mesh-gradient ground, film-grain skin. The current direction of the work.
